parameters.description:
Indexable data-structures can be arrays, lists, dataframes, scipy
sparse matrices or pandas dataframes with consistent first dimension.
parameters.name: arrays
parameters.type_doc: sequence of array-like of shape (n_samples,) or (n_samples, n_outputs)

parameters.description:
If float, should be between 0.0 and 1.0 and represent the proportion
of the dataset to include in the test split. If int, represents the
absolute number of test samples. If None, the value is set to the
complement of the train size. If ``train_size`` is also None, it will
be set to 0.25.
parameters.name: test_size

parameters.description:
If float, should be between 0.0 and 1.0 and represent the
proportion of the dataset to include in the train split. If
int, represents the absolute number of train samples. If None,
the value is automatically set to the complement of the test size.
parameters.name: train_size

parameters.description:
Controls the shuffling applied to the data before applying the split.
Pass an int for reproducible output across multiple function calls.
See :term:`Glossary <random_state>`.
parameters.name: random_state
parameters.type_doc: int, RandomState instance or None, default=None

parameters.description:
Whether or not to shuffle the data before splitting. If shuffle=False
then stratify must be None.
parameters.name: shuffle

parameters.description:
If not None, data is split in a stratified fashion, using this as
the class labels.
Read more in the :ref:`User Guide <stratification>`.
parameters.name: stratify

returns.description:
List containing train-test split of inputs.

.. versionadded:: 0.16
    If the input is sparse, the output will be a
    ``scipy.sparse.csr_matrix``. Else, output type is the same as the
    input type.
returns.name: splitting

signature: train_test_split(*arrays, test_size=None, train_size=None, random_state=None, shuffle=True, stratify=None)
summary: Split arrays or matrices into random train and test subsets.
